div.head: Ordal 4.3
div.ab: 7 ne sy þær nan oðer spǽc inne, buton þæt hig biddan God ælmihtig georne, þæt he þæt soðeste geswytelie.
Et non sit ibi (illic) alia locutio, quam ut precentur sedulo Deum (patrem) omnipotentem, ut ueritatem suam (in eo) manifestare dignetur.
and ne sy þær nan oðer spǽc inne, buton þæt hig biddan God Ælmihtig georne, þæt he soðeste geswytelie.
Und kein anderes Sprechen finde drinnen statt, ausser dass sie Gott den allmächtigen eifrig bitten sollen, dass er das Wahrste offenbaren möge.
And let there be no other speech inside, except that they earnestly pray God almighty that he reveal the truest.
and no other words shall be spoken in the church, except that God be earnestly prayed to make clear the whole truth.
